title: Bound on the family size
statement: Let $s\in\mathbb R$ with $s\ge 0$, and let $\varepsilon\in\mathbb Q$ satisfy $0<\varepsilon\le \tfrac12$. Define $N=\max\{1,\lceil 4s^2/\varepsilon\rceil\}$. Then $N+1\le 6(s+1)^2/\varepsilon$.
